exam_scheme.note: The KPSC First Division Assistant (FDA) recruitment examination comprises 3 papers: Paper 1 is a qualifying Kannada language paper (SSLC standard); Papers 2 and 3 are competitive objective papers evaluated to formulate the final merit and selection list.

stages.source_label: KPSC Group-C Degree Level Syllabus & Examination Scheme (KCSR Rules 2021)

papers.qualifying_threshold: 35% (50 marks out of 150; exempted for candidates having studied Kannada in SSLC or higher)

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General English OR General Kannada (Samanya Kannada / Samanya English)
Paper 3: General Knowledge (Samanya Jnana — Constitution, Indian & Karnataka History, Geography, State Schemes)

stages.source_label: KPSC Recruitment Procedures and Document Verification Guidelines

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Original Academic and Reservation Documents
papers.qualifying_threshold: Verification of 1:1 or 1:2 merit shortlist candidates

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per Karnataka Civil Services Revised Pay Rules under Karnataka State Pay Commission matrix (Scale ₹27,650–₹52,650; Entry Basic Pay ₹27,650). In-hand estimate applies mandatory project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 and city-wise HRA (Bengaluru/Zone A at 27%, Class B at 18%, Class C at 9%).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Karnataka Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules and KPSC FDA Recruitment Specification
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay of ₹27,650 at mandatory 58% DA (₹16,037) plus HRA ranging from 9% (₹2,489) in non-metro taluk centers to 27% (₹7,466) in Bengaluru Bruhat Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) areas, less statutory NPS (10% Basic+DA), Group Insurance (KGID), and professional tax deductions.
official_perks: Karnataka Government Employees Insurance Scheme (KGID) cover
Medical reimbursement under Karnataka Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
House Rent Allowance (HRA) indexed to posting city tier
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) within Karnataka and across India as per State Service rules
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with full State Government matching contribution
Earned leave accumulation and encashment benefits as per KCSR
